alt.description:
Describe what the image shows for the task at hand. Required and nonblank
for an informative image. Omit it for a decorative image.

decorative.description: Hide the media from assistive technology when it conveys no information.

fallback-label.description:
Localizable fallback label. An informative fallback appends the image's
description, when available, to this label.

fit.description: Cover fills the frame. Contain preserves the whole image in it.

loading.description: Native loading hint. Use eager for a critical image above the fold.

radius.description: Corner radius of the media frame.

ratio.description:
An explicit ratio reserves the same frame before load and on failure.
Auto reserves 16:9 first and uses the intrinsic ratio after load.

src.description: Relative or HTTP(S) image URL. Refused sources are left unloaded.

--ki-image-caption-fg.description: Text colour of the visible caption.

--ki-image-caption-font-size.description: Type size of the visible caption.

--ki-image-caption-gap.description: Space between the image frame and its caption.

--ki-image-caption-line-height.description: Line height of the visible caption.

--ki-image-fallback-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter applied behind the media surface.

--ki-image-fallback-bg.description: Solid fill behind the image and fallback symbol.

--ki-image-fallback-bg-image.description: Optional background image over the media fill.

--ki-image-fallback-icon-size.description: Inline and block size of the unavailable-image symbol.

--ki-image-fallback-icon-stroke-width.description: Stroke width of the unavailable-image symbol.

--ki-image-radius.description: Corner radius of the default media frame.

--ki-image-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the medium media frame.

component.description:
Displays one accessible image in a reserved frame, with an optional caption
and a fallback if the source is refused or fails to load.

ki-error.description:
Reports a load failure or rejected URL once per source attempt. Bubbles
and crosses shadow boundaries so consumers can observe it on a surface.

caption.description: The figcaption carrying the slotted caption.

fallback.description: The unavailable-image indicator inside the frame.

figure.description: The figure containing the frame and optional caption.

frame.description: The reserved media box and its shape and backing surface.

image.description: The native image and its fit within the frame.
